_comment: Project-scoped MCP registration. Claude Code loads this automatically when
the OmniSim directory is opened, so `omnisim` tools are available with no
install and no `claude mcp add`. Cursor and Claude Desktop need their own
`python -m omnisim_mcp` with PYTHONPATH is used deliberately instead of the
`omnisim-mcp` console script: that script only exists after `pip install -e`
and lands in the installing interpreter's Scripts/ dir, which an MCP client's
spawn environment often does not inherit on Windows. The package is pure
stdlib, so this form needs no install at all.
The server is a PROXY to the harness on :6789. Start it first, from this
directory: `python -m omnisim harness`. `harness_status` reports on the
harness, not the engine -- it can read reachable on an install that cannot
load a world, so run `python -m omnisim doctor` if a load fails.
